plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Heavy Equipment/Ag Technology, Associate of Applied Science' program page (Major Code: 4564A), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/trade-and-industry-department/heavy-equipment-ag-technology/heavy-equipmentag-technology-associate-of-applied-science/ . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the five semester tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals 17/16/9/12/6), including the 'Summer Semester Freshman Year' term. TRUE award: Associate of Applied Science (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables sum 17+16+9+12+6 = 60. Choice slots: MATH GE / COMM GE / SOCS GE / ELEC GE ('Any additional Gen. Ed.') are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice). DIET 158 Advanced Occupational Communication (1 credit) is an occupational course, categorized as major. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks the page '*Prerequisite or Corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
